The limit is 0xff = 255 local variables. So I can have at most 254 local variables (plus 1 for self). That gives `s->sp = 255` at the start. But I need `cursp() > 255` at the time of the `genjmp2` call.

Let me think about this differently. I need `s->sp > 255` at the time of the `genjmp2` call. With 254 local variables, `s->sp = 255` at the start. Then I need to push at least 1 more value onto the stack.

In the `NODE_CASE` handling, the `case` value is pushed onto the stack. So if I have a `case` statement with a value, `s->sp` would be 256 at the time of the `genjmp2` call.
